seo_title: About Optimax Eye Specialist | Malaysia's first LASIK provider since 1995
seo_description: Optimax introduced laser vision correction to Malaysia in 1995. Today we care for patients across 25 hospitals and clinics in Malaysia and Cambodia.

hero.subhead: For more than 31 years we've been helping Malaysians achieve lasting clarity, comfort and confidence in their vision.

story.title: From one clinic in TTDI to a regional name.
paragraphs: Optimax opened in Taman Tun Dr Ismail, Kuala Lumpur, in 1995 — and introduced laser vision correction to Malaysia. For many of our first patients, waking up without glasses was life-changing.

Since then we've grown into one of the most trusted eye care providers in Southeast Asia, expanding into cataract, glaucoma, dry eye and children's eye care. Patients now travel to us from Malaysia, Indonesia, the Philippines, Singapore, Thailand, Australia, China, Hong Kong and Japan.
Today Optimax is listed on the Main Market of Bursa Malaysia, and our headquarters sits at Republik TTDI — a few minutes from where it all began.

timeline.title: How laser vision correction has evolved.
timeline.intro: We've adopted each new generation of technology — so patients get safer, gentler and faster treatment.

items.title: Surface laser (ASA / PRK)
items.text: Our first laser treatment. Effective, but vision took weeks to recover.

items.title: LASIK with a blade
items.text: Same visual results as ASA, with recovery in days instead of weeks.

items.title: Bladeless Femto-LASIK
items.text: A femtosecond laser made the flap more precise, accurate and safe.

items.title: ZEISS SMILE® & SMILE® pro
items.text: No flap at all — fewer complications, better comfort and about 8 seconds of laser time.

people.title: Giving back to the community that built us.
people.text: We started small, and we haven't forgotten who supported us. Together with corporate partners and charities, we invest in programmes that bring eye care to more people.

items.text: Restoring sight for those who couldn't otherwise afford it.

warranty.title: Lifetime vision warranty.
warranty.text: Our lifetime warranty programme, structured aftercare and nationwide follow-up network mean you're looked after long after treatment day. Ask about the terms at your consultation.
